name: Pork Lo Mein with Bell Pepper & Sugar Snap Peas

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (1 quarter coin = 57 g) linguine pasta

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, honey, and crushed red pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
3 tsp cornstarch
¾ tsp honey
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice pork crosswise into strips; transfer to a small bowl.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Wash peas and bell peppers. Seed and slice the peppers into strips.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
3 orange bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pork and stir fry until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once pork has been transferred, coat skillet with more oil. Add garlic, ginger, peas, and peppers; stir fry until peas are bright green and peppers are tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Add pork, pasta, and sauce to skillet. Toss until noodles are well coated and sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place lo mein on a plate and enjoy!
